source_refs.note: 4. Kingdom Animalia: a main subheading of 1.3 Salient features of the kingdoms of domain Eukarya, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 13-13.

blocks.text: This kingdom of eukaryotes includes animals which are eukaryotic, multicellular and heterotrophic. They develop from embryos. They ingest food and digest it within their bodies.
